notes: OTA update check is now rate-limit-proof: the app reads a tiny static version.json (raw.githubusercontent + Pages, no API quota) as its primary update source, with the GitHub Releases API only as a fallback. Phones on shared mobile NAT IPs were silently hitting the API's 60 req/hr cap, so the check died and updates never appeared — fixed. Pure content update — applies in-app via OTA.
